articles.title: Augustus raises $180 million to build a clearing bank for the AI and stablecoin era
articles.snippet: The firm, freshly valued at $1 billion, aims to replace legacy correspondent banking with always-on infrastructure that connects traditional payment systems and stablecoins.

articles.title: BIS warns stablecoins could weaken capital controls in emerging markets
articles.snippet: Researchers found dollar-backed stablecoins are less affected by capital controls than traditional bank deposits, raising new questions about monetary sovereignty in emerging markets.

articles.title: CoinShares debuts Bitcoin mining ETF in Europe entrance
articles.snippet: The UCITS ETF, CoinShares’ first in Europe, began trading on Deutsche Börse Xetra, tracking a rules-based index of publicly listed BTC miners.

articles.title: Robinhood-backed DEX Arcus expands with tokenized assets, perps
articles.snippet: Arcus, built by the dYdX team, adds tokenized stocks and perpetual futures on Robinhood Chain as platforms compete to bring traditional assets onchain.

articles.title: Russian parliament passes law regulating crypto market
articles.snippet: The State Duma legislation creates a regulated framework for crypto market participants and now moves to President Vladimir Putin for his signature before becoming law.
